I haven't saved the draft yet. Pree is an account manager on the Central team, not the owner of Thornbury. Finance figures like a per-seat rate can only go to the account owner, Anselm or June unless one of them approves, and that holds for drafts too.

I've messaged June Osei-Lark directly to ask for approval and logged the request. Once she or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft to Pree (psundaram@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate" and the $2,314-a-seat figure, so you can send it yourself.
